no_adcom_quote.quote: Since none of the above factors is met, the matter at issue does not call for a request to convene an advisory committee meeting.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the ASCLERA (polidocanol) NDA. Although the Cross-Discipline Team Leader review notes the product is a first-in-class drug that under Section 505(s) would ordinarily require referral to an advisory committee, the Division declined to convene one, reasoning that a similar liquid sclerosant (Sotradecol) was already FDA-approved, polidocanol had decades of marketing experience in many countries, and none of the three FDA criteria (public interest, controversy, special expertise) were met. The Summary Review concurs that the review team did not recommend an Advisory Committee, noting the only minor controversy concerned a potential REMS, which an AC was not believed to add much to.
